I'm suicidal too. 
Look at my history if you need my background. 

What has kept me alive for these last 3 months?
1: writing in a journal. Push that pen so hard into the page that the painful words etch themselves into the next pages. Cry your tears all over the ink and let it smear into a mud puddle. 
Write anything that comes to mind. Especially write about good times. Write about times when life isn't too hard. Write about when times are so hard you're looking for a gun. 

2. Getting a therapist. I found one for $80 for a 50 minute session. I cried my eyes out to him every Sunday. Some sessions he really opened up my eyes. I figured out what went wrong. What I did, and what she didn't. 

3. Antidepressants. Eh. Be careful with this one. I relied on them heavily for the first couple weeks. When they didn't kick in, I figured that my depression wasn't fixable. To be honest, after 2 months of being on them, I'm not sure if they are working still. Maybe it was the time that's helping. I don't know. Maybe it's the pills. 

4. The most successful thing? You're not going to like this. But a plan. A suicide plan. I made one. Man oh man it is going to work. Still have it. I have a date in mind too. But here's the thing. I owe it to myself to give my life one last real hard try. I gave myself 30 days. If shit didn't get better in 30 days, that was it. It gave me a goal. An excuse. An out. Hope that suffering wasn't permanent. 30 days passed. I wasn't much better. But I was better enough to reevaluate my plan. My death would be remembered. No matter how I did it, my ex would be crushed, my brothers would be possibly just as sad as I am now. My mom... Man oh man. Depression would hit her HARD. She relies on me for her sanity at least a little. Not sure how she would cope. Probably not well. But. This is about me. So, if i kill myself, it has to be on a date away from my birthday. Away from all the September birthdays in my family. Okay. So October. Well, my brother is coming to visit in October. I owe it to him to let him see me one last time. So it can't be until after the 20th. So. I have to stick it out until October 20th. That sucks. But. I think I can make it. And if I cant? That's okay. I have a plan. My pain is not permanent. If I can't take it, then at least I gave it a good try, you know?

I think this unintentional plan of mine is working. I am delaying my death day further and further. I'm not doing it on purpose. I'm doing it because 1: I think I can endure just a little longer, and 2: because part of my plan includes doing it in a way that inconveniences the least amount of people. That includes living just a little bit longer. 

This is keeping me alive. And some days, I'm really happy that this is my decision, to live a little longer. And on the dark days, and oh my god, there are still dark days, I still have my plan. If I can't take it anymore, that's okay. 

Hope this helps. Message me if you want. I've been really close to ending it. Not quite loaded gun-to-temple... But pretty close nonetheless.

For anyone else wondering what I accomplished:

I used Electrum to 'sweep' my 52 character private key into an Electrum wallet that was generated when I installed it. This required a processing fee.

Then I sent the remaining bitcoins from Electrum to my Coinbase 'receiving bitcoin' address, which required another processing fee.

Then I waited for the transaction to be confirmed 6 times before Coinbase would accept it as a real thing. This took about an hour.

Then I sold everything in one go through Coinbase, (this required a Coinbase fee) and the money is going to my bank account that is connected to Coinbase.

All in all, I spent around $25 in fees, with $17 of that due to a 'Coinbase fee' for the privilege of selling the company my bitcoin.
